name: convert_dna_to_rna
description: Convert a DNA sequence into its corresponding RNA sequence by replacing thymine (T) with uracil (U). Use this tool when you have a DNA sequence that you need to transcribe into RNA. Do NOT use this tool for sequences that are already RNA or for other types of biological transformations (e.g., protein synthesis).

parameters.name: dna_sequence
parameters.description: The DNA sequence to convert, represented as a string of nucleotide codes (A, T, C, G). Must not contain any whitespace, line breaks, or invalid characters. Length must be between 1 and 10,000 characters.

rna_sequence.description: The resulting RNA sequence after conversion, with thymine (T) replaced by uracil (U).

return_schema.description: Object containing the converted RNA sequence.
